lines.text: Hi Bernard, how's the leg been since last time?
The leg's been calmer, work's been manic, no tingling though.
That's good news. And the pain in the calf?
Since last time the calf pain only comes on after an hour of driving, though don't hold me to the hour.
Let me have a look at the leg raise again.
That's up to seventy degrees now, it was forty when I first saw you.
On long drives, pull over every forty five minutes and walk around the car for a couple of minutes.
If the leg pain spreads to both legs, or you notice any change in your waterworks, ring 999 straight away.
Will do. Same time in two weeks?
